name: Gamma
shortDescription: Makes presentations, documents and web pages with AI.
bestFor: A good-looking presentation from a topic or your notes in a few minutes
about: Gamma makes presentations, documents and simple websites from a prompt or your notes. You describe the topic, approve an outline, pick a theme, and it builds the full deck with layouts and images.
You can then edit every card, and export to PowerPoint, PDF or Google Slides.
useCases: Turn notes or a document into slides
features: Full deck from a prompt or pasted text
Export to PowerPoint, PDF and Google Slides

howToUse.title: Sign up
howToUse.text: Create a free account at gamma.app.

howToUse.title: Choose Generate or Paste in text
howToUse.text: Type a topic, or paste your notes so the slides use your content.

howToUse.title: Edit the outline
howToUse.text: Change, add or remove slide titles before it builds.

howToUse.title: Pick a theme
howToUse.text: Choose a look and let Gamma build the slides.

howToUse.title: Edit and export
howToUse.text: Fix the text, swap images, then present or export.

tips: Paste your own notes for accurate content instead of only a topic.
Check every fact and number before presenting.
examplePrompt: A 10-slide presentation for university students on how to save money each month, with simple tips, a sample budget and a short quiz at the end.
limitations: Free credits are one-time, not monthly.
Exports to PowerPoint can need small layout fixes.
freePlanDetails: 400 one-time credits when you sign up.
pricingNote: US prices. App store prices in Pakistan may be different.

name: Beautiful.ai
shortDescription: Presentation software with smart slides that design themselves.
bestFor: Professional business slides that always stay neat as you edit
about: Beautiful.ai uses "smart slides": when you add text or items, the layout adjusts itself so slides always look neat and on-brand.
It can also create a first draft of a deck from a prompt, and teams can share brand templates.
useCases: Team presentations with a shared brand
features: Smart slide templates that adjust automatically
AI deck drafts from a prompt

howToUse.title: Start a trial
howToUse.text: Sign up at beautiful.ai and start the free trial.

howToUse.title: Create a deck
howToUse.text: Generate a draft from a prompt or start with a template.

howToUse.title: Add smart slides
howToUse.text: Pick slide types like timeline, chart or comparison and add your content.

howToUse.title: Share or export
howToUse.text: Present from the browser, share a link, or export to PowerPoint.

tips: Choose the slide type first, then add content, so the layout works for you.
Set your brand colours and logo before making many decks.
limitations: No free plan, only a 14-day trial that needs a card.
Less freedom than PowerPoint if you want a custom layout.
pricingNote: US prices. Some pages still show $12/month, so check the website.

name: Napkin AI
shortDescription: Turns your text into diagrams, flowcharts and infographics.
bestFor: Turning a paragraph into a clear diagram or infographic for slides and posts
about: Napkin AI reads your text and suggests visuals for it: diagrams, flowcharts, timelines, mind maps and infographics. You choose one, change the style, and export it.
It is great for making slides, reports and LinkedIn posts easier to understand.
features: Export as PNG, SVG or PDF

howToUse.title: Sign up
howToUse.text: Create a free account at napkin.ai.

howToUse.title: Paste your text
howToUse.text: Create a new napkin and paste a paragraph or list.

howToUse.title: Generate a visual
howToUse.text: Click the spark icon next to the text and pick a suggested diagram.

howToUse.title: Style and export
howToUse.text: Change colours and icons, then export.

tips: Short, structured text (steps or a list) gives the clearest diagrams.
Export as SVG for sharp images in presentations.
limitations: Free exports may have a watermark.
It makes diagrams, not full slide decks.
